Handle.title: Handle
Handle.description: A unique username or organization name starting with @, like @my-org.

ExtensionName.title: Extension Name
ExtensionName.description: The name of an extension — lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens (e.g. my-skill).

Version.title: Version
Version.description: A semver version like 1.0.0. Ranges are not allowed here.

NonPackExtensionFqn.title: Non-Pack Extension FQN
NonPackExtensionFqn.description: Extension identifier restricted to non-pack types (skills, mcps, subagents, rules, hooks, knowledge).

VersionRange.title: Version Range
VersionRange.description: A semver version range like ^1.0.0, ~2.3.0, >=1.0.0 <3.0.0, or an exact version 1.2.3. Use "*" to always resolve to the latest available version.

PackMemberRegistrySource.description: A self-describing Registry locator for one Pack member.

PackMemberConstraint.description: A version range that inherits the Pack source, or an explicit Registry locator and range.

manifestContentIdentity.description: Semantic consistency digest over the accepted Pack identity, manifest version, and dependency declarations. It is not an authenticity signature.

dependencies.description: Map of fully-qualified non-Pack extension names to inherited ranges or explicit Registry locators. Packs cannot depend on other Packs.

integrity.description: SRI sha512 of the published archive, verified against downloaded bytes before extraction. The supply-chain guarantee for registry installs; never compared against installed files on disk.
